title: wedelia oblonga
intro: Wedelia oblonga, commonly known as Dandicut, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the Asteraceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion, thereby providing relief from various health issues such as fever, cough, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Wedelia oblonga are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, terpenoids, and glycosides, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's extracts have been traditionally used to treat various ailments, including skin conditions, and its bioactive compounds have been studied for their potential in developing new medicinal products.
